free_text: Biopsy is recommended due to the convergence of high-risk imaging features and aggressive biochemical markers. The PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right posterior peripheral zone, combined with a significant PSA velocity of 2.9 ng/mL/yr and a steep PSA trend from 11.9 ng/mL to 22.0 ng/mL, strongly warrants tissue sampling. Although the DRE was normal, the high-risk imaging and biochemical trajectory override this finding, aligning with the statistical prior.
